facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Third-party landing pages with built-in Pixel/CAPI integration - ToneDen, Feature.fm, Hypeddit, Linkfire - routing clicks to Spotify via trackable redirect URLs
The ad -> Pixel-equipped smart link -> Spotify funnel is the music-specific hack because no Pixel can live on Spotify

Rebuildable at zero cost: a self-hosted landing page (any static host) with an open-source analytics snippet (e.g., self-hosted Plausible/Matomo) tracking pageview -> Spotify-click events, plus manual UTM tagging
Correct funnel structure yields 35-45% higher click-to-stream conversion than direct-to-Spotify ads (Chartlex, 2,400+ campaigns)
